tableHint: Search + Table + Modal demo with local mock data.
name: Name
formHint: Demo of Form / Descriptions / Tree / Upload / DictSelect.
uploadHint: Files are not uploaded to a real server.
themeHint: Switch standard blue, teal, violet, amber, or a custom brand color in Settings.
pageContainerHint: Page shell. The title slot renders the heading. List pages set scrollable to false.
brandLogoHint: Brand mark. Color follows the current theme.
iconHint: Renders a sidebar icon by name. Unknown names use the fallback icon.
emptyHint: Empty placeholder. Falls back to the shared empty text.
copyTextHint: Click the text to copy it.
dictSelectHint: Pass options directly, or load them with loader.
appFormHint: Renders input, select, date, switch, and dict fields from a schema.
appSearchHint: Extra fields can be expanded. Search and reset stay in the page.
appTableHint: The body is capped by the remaining height and does not stretch when there are few rows.
uploadHint: Without an upload URL, nothing is sent to a server.
modalHint: The dialog attaches to body so the layout does not clip it.
drawerHint: The drawer attaches to body and fits longer content.
imagePreviewHint: Opens a preview for the given image URLs.
